//: Every test that lives in `aab/`, typechecked: the three
schools' engines and the course player, driven in linkedom,
the three that drive a real browser through Playwright, and
the four case-study models beside `portfolio/`.
They are here rather than in `aab/src/tsconfig.json` because
that config COMPILES. It emits every module in `aab/src/` to
the address it is served from and a declaration for each into
`app/src/types/`, so a test added to it would be built into
`aab/` and published beside them. This one emits nothing and
exists only to read.
Nothing typechecked these until they stopped being `.mjs`,
which is the trap `scripts/check-types.ts` was written for:
node strips the annotations without reading them, so a `.ts`
nobody checks is a `.js` wearing them, and that is worse than
the `.mjs` it replaced because a reader now believes them.
That check runs this config, so the rename and the types
arrive together or the build says so.
It is listed there with `needs: app/`, which is the one entry
whose directory is not its own: three of these import
`playwright`, and that is a devDependency of `app/` rather
than of the root. CI runs `npm ci` at the root and nowhere
else, so this config skips there, loudly: a skip is not a
pass.
